usedFor: gate holds entries, and HubSpot updates a deal after each “Gate Status Changed” through “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Gate Status Changed” in gate, then “Update Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: When an entry's status moves, the deal's properties follow, so the CRM matches the gate.

watchOut: “Gate Status Changed” is polling, and “Update Deal” needs the deal ID, so carry it in the entry.
